name: T12
summary: T12 is TetraBOT’s mobile humanoid for inspection and physical operation in industrial and energy environments. Its sensor-equipped upper body and two articulated arms sit on a tall mobile platform. The manufacturer positions it for tasks that combine recognition, material handling and timely intervention, including work in confined industrial spaces. T12 was publicly exhibited at the World Intelligent Manufacturing Conference in November 2025; present commercial delivery availability has not been confirmed.
